# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_DURATION_3BAR

**Filed:** 2026-08-19  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** parameter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Shorter EMA ribbon duration increases sensitivity to trend changes, improving entry timing for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON on J's winner days by reducing lag during rapid reversals. Testing N=2,3,4 bars (vs baseline 15) seeks to capture more of the initial move while avoiding whipsaws in chop.

## Mechanism

Parameter: `max_ribbon_duration_bars` in BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON logic. Entry requires EMA ribbon (Fast < Pivot < Slow) to have maintained bearish alignment for at least N bars. Shorter N allows faster entry after ribbon flip; longer N filters noise but delays entry. Exit logic unchanged (chart stop, chandelier profit-lock, premium stop).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline. Based on ITM-2 0DTE put premium ~$1.00 entry, risking 50% per trade.
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 used 6 anchor days (3 winners, 3 losers) from Jan 2025-Jun 2026. High overfit risk due to small N; walk-forward OOS required.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window pending)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days not yet validated)
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: 5/07 loser 2 (-$120 baseline) could become -$150 if whipsaw increases losses. Max drawdown: potential -$500/day if N too low causes frequent losses. Blow-up scenario: persistent whipsaw in low-VIX regime erodes capital via repeated -50% stops.
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days (estimated) = 68% of P&L (based on baseline concentration; N=3 may alter distribution).
